concept_tasks.prompt: Concept for a single game-ready 3D environment prop in the exact style and wood family of these reference boards: a standalone timber mooring post about 1.3 m tall. A thick round weathered wooden post with a slightly domed cap and a dark iron band near the top, a coil of tan rope wrapped around the middle of the post, and a polished brass mooring ring bolted to the side. A small muted teal paint band near the base. Warm weathered wood browns, stylised hand-painted Tetherbound look, chunky readable shape. No red, no oxblood. Isolated object only, no ground, no water, no text, plain background, even lighting, no cast shadow.

visual_verdict: Accept as candidate: chunky weathered timber post, dark iron band, rope coil and brass ring are cleanly separated in mesh; teal base band; no red. Diameter about 0.56 m at 1.3 m height (chunky, stylised).
inspection: concept views and Meshy thumbnail inspected; normal-shaded orthographic views checked (scratchpad views_post.png)
